reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing exported getScheduledAmount and routes every ranged-amount site to it instead of keeping per-site midpoint code.

duplication.why: Removes five inline midpoint copies (forecast, schedule-template, two in schedules/app.ts, schedule previews) and adds no new duplication.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module that already owned getScheduledAmount and is imported by both server and shared callers.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the amount rule, its call sites, tests and a release note; consolidating the sites is what makes the rule change land everywhere.

maintainability.why: One definition now decides the missing/number/range cases for every consumer; only schedule-template keeps a redundant isbetween ternary around the call.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, used by forecast-schedules normalizeSchedule, schedule-template createScheduleList, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.
